edits.before: Your AoE and On the Chase hard out-scale an immobile poke mage in teamfights.
edits.after: Your AoE and On the Hunt hard out-scale an immobile poke mage in teamfights.

edits.before: You hard out-scale Ziggs in teamfights: he's a squishy immobile poke mage, and your Ricochet AoE plus On the Chase (R) team-wide speed let you cleave his team and close the gap he relies on to kite. Spell Shield his Satchel knockback or a Mega Inferno Bomb to dive the backline, and space so his Minefield can't zone your engage. Sustained carry DPS beats burst poke once fights start.

Spell Shield his Satchel knockback or a Mega Inferno Bomb to dive the backline, and space so his Minefield can't zone your engage. Sustained carry DPS beats burst poke once fights start.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — and your tower’s execution clause; he is catchable while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E Spell Shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge (W) is down 20s early, 12s at max — his knockback escape and your tower's execution window; catchable only while it's down. Short Fuse resets his auto — the wind-up is your step-back cue. - Spell Shield (E) is the lifeline, 24s early to 18s at max.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Push with Ricochet through his Minefield zoning — Boomerang Blade clears mines from range before you walk up.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Satchel Charge deals percent-health damage — stacking armour doesn't answer it, so respect the knockback near your tower.
